ms.report:
Response to Reviewer Feedback

Thank you for your thoughtful reviews of our Milestone 2 submission. Below, we address both the approved and not approved feedback:
Approved Feedback: We appreciate your recognition of the core functionality and validation of our proof-of-concept. We will include more detailed performance benchmarks and expand our test coverage documentation in our upcoming Initial Testing and Developer Feedback Phase (Milestone 3).
Not Approved Feedback: We acknowledge concerns about partial and untested implementations of Groth16, PLONK, and Bulletproofs verifiers.
・Clarification: Foundational code for each protocol is in place. We recognize that the full verifier implementations and corresponding test coverage are ongoing.
・Remediation: Our Initial Testing and Developer Feedback Phase (Milestone 3) will address these gaps by:
・Completing and testing the Groth16, PLONK, and Bulletproofs verifiers
・Providing comprehensive unit tests for all code paths
・Utilizing property-based testing through the Aiken Fuzzing library
・Documenting test results and performance benchmarks

We appreciate the feedback and remain committed to a transparent and high-quality release. We look forward to demonstrating our progress during the Initial Testing and Developer Feedback Phase.
Proof of Achievement Submission
Milestone 2: Core Functionality Development
This submission confirms the successful completion of Milestone 2 – Core Functionality Development. The ZKP library demonstrates foundational functionality, integrates key cryptographic components, and includes proof-of-concept verifiers to support off-chain constructed zero-knowledge proofs.
Key Accomplishments
・ZKP Library Implementation: The library provides infrastructure for verifying zero-knowledge proofs constructed off-chain. It aligns with the technical specifications defined in Milestone 1 and is designed for integration with Cardano smart contracts.
